title: OOMKilled — Container Memory Exhaustion
description: Container exceeded memory limit and was killed by the Linux OOM killer. Requires immediate memory limit increase and model restart.
root_causes: Memory limit too low for model artifact size
Large batch request causing spike above limit

remediation_steps.description: Increase memory limit to 2x or minimum 1Gi
Restart the predictor pod with new limits

prevention: Monitor container_memory_working_set_bytes; alert at 80% of limit
Use VPA (Vertical Pod Autoscaler) recommendations as baseline
Set memory requests = limits for Guaranteed QoS class
